subject: Heading out tonight - quick May handoff
snippet: Kayla, quick note before I head down to Spartanburg. Quick May handoff so you are not stuck guessing what...
body:
Kayla,

Quick note before I head down to Spartanburg tonight. Mom's caregiver is rotating Tuesday and I want to be there a couple of days ahead, so I will be away from the Society books until June 7 at the earliest.

Here is where things stand on your May items so you are not stuck guessing:

I went ahead and ran your linen-rental reimbursement (the tablecloths from Mountain Linens for the reception) through the books on Friday. That one should already show as settled in QuickBooks under your vendor record.

The catering invoice from Appalachian and the audio rental from Foothills are both still sitting on the desk waiting for your May claim. I never got around to either of those, so include them when you build the claim for Frances.

Frances mentioned you also paid cash for parking the night of the reception, so include that too.

For the Ridge Print invoice, just enter the line total off the page when you build the claim. That's what we agreed on.

Frances will want the May claim before the June 4 board meeting. Sorry to dump this in your lap on the way out the door.

Linda

subject: Re: May closeout
snippet: Kayla - thanks again for jumping in on this with Linda away. Whenever you can get the claim to me before Thursday I'll...
body:
Kayla,

Thanks again for jumping in on this with Linda away. Whenever you can get the claim over to me before Thursday I will get it routed and we will be set for the board on the 4th.

The reception turned out beautifully. Strong turnout, good press coverage, exactly what we were hoping for.

Frances
